title: Clawd X Digest
summary: RSA-896 Factored in 30 GPU-Years (10 Days): Cryptographers publish a 450-bit factor of the 270-digit RSA-896 challenge using 2,048 GPUs, prompting community calculations that legacy hardware roots of trust like the Nintendo DSi's RSA-1024 would take roughly ~900 GPU-years to crack.

Anthropic Opus 5 Praise vs Harness Fatigue: Zhu Liang reports Anthropic's Opus 5 has reached frontier dominance over competitors, while Theo highlights developer fatigue over fragmented agent harnesses as builders plead for universal runtime layers across Claude and Codex.

Emil Kowalski's Agent Design Skills Near 40k Stars: Linear designer Emil Kowalski open-sources a curated skill suite (including Apple Design principles from WWDC, animation review, and UI library selection) giving coding agents refined aesthetic judgment and native-grade micro-interactions.

Sub-1B Decision Models Advance with Laya-MLX & Game Micro: Developers demonstrate Laya running locally on Apple Silicon MLX at 60 decisions/sec (<1GB RAM) playing Snake, while Jev is deployed to orchestrate independent per-unit micro-management and kiting in Warcraft III.

Terence Tao Urges AI Deceleration Amid Rapid Advances: Renowned mathematician Terence Tao cautions that the breakneck pace of AI capabilities is expanding faster than humanity can safely integrate, arguing there is no imperative reason to rush frontier deployment.

items.title: @pengchujin: Emil Kowalski Releases AI Agent Design Skills Suite for Native UI Polish
items.body: Linear designer Emil Kowalski open-sources a widely adopted collection of agent skills—including Apple Design (WWDC principles), animation review, and Swift idioms—bringing human-grade aesthetic nuance, component hierarchy, and feedback timing to autonomous frontend agents.

items.title: @paradite_: Anthropic's Opus 5 Surpasses Fable 5.1 Across Real-World Workflows
items.body: Zhu Liang reports that recent upgrades to Anthropic's Opus 5 have propelled it well ahead of Fable 5.1, urging developers to migrate workflows to the newly refined frontier model.

items.title: @NousResearch: Hermes Agent Launches Official Plugin Catalog with 100 Extensions
items.body: Nous Research rolls out the official Hermes Agent Plugin Catalog, featuring 4 core system tools alongside 96 verified community integrations for desktop mods, cross-platform environments, and specialized browsing.

items.title: @Gas1688: Why Production AI Agents Require Principled Harness Engineering Over Raw Demos
items.body: Reflecting on LangChain's 'Agents From Scratch,' a practitioner breaks down why toy agent scripts fail in production, emphasizing LLM-as-a-judge evaluations, structured human-in-the-loop boundaries, and persistent memory.

items.title: @jiang_kev: PolarBrowser Secures $5.7M to Scale Autonomous Enterprise Web Navigation
items.body: PolarBrowser lands $5.7M in seed financing for its web agent browser, claiming superiority over OpenAI and Anthropic across agent benchmarks after executing 4.5M+ browser actions for enterprise workflows.

items.title: @AndyL5cc: Codex Automates Multi-Account Social Content Operations End-to-End
items.body: A creator documents using Codex to manage Xiaohongshu accounts autonomously—from niche ideation and copy drafting to performance analytics—generating 3M+ impressions and 2,000 followers in under a week.

items.title: @sweis & @__soragoto__: 450-Bit Factor of RSA-896 Found in 30 GPU-Years
items.body: Cryptographer Steve Weis reveals a 450-bit factor of the 270-digit RSA-896 challenge number. The computation consumed ~30 GPU-years across up to 2,048 GPUs in 10 calendar days, sparking analysis that legacy RSA-1024 hardware roots (like Nintendo DSi) are within reach of ~900 GPU-years.

items.title: @theo: Developers Plead for Universal Harness as Tool Switching Fatigue Mounts
items.body: Theo highlights growing community exhaustion from constantly context-switching between Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, amplifying calls for a unified agent harness that works seamlessly across competing foundation models.

items.title: @mizorewww: Laya-MLX Runs Sub-1B Decision Models at 60 FPS Locally on M3 Max
items.body: Developer mizore ports Laya (a fast text-probability decision engine similar to Jev) to Apple Silicon MLX, demonstrating 50x speedups, sub-1GB memory consumption, and 60 decisions per second playing Snake locally.

items.title: @techNmak: Deep Architectural Dissection of PEFT: LoRA, QLoRA, VeRA, and Delta-LoRA
items.body: A comprehensive technical guide demystifies the PEFT landscape, contrasting which parameters, activation memories, or base weight updates move between LoRA-FA, QLoRA, VeRA, Delta-LoRA, and LoRA+.

items.title: @KKaWSB: Micro-Managing Warcraft III Units with Individual Jev Decision Models
items.body: Gamers experiment with assigning independent Jev-based tactical decision micro-models to every unit in a Warcraft III army, achieving automated hero-level kiting and focus-firing behavior.

items.title: @argofowl: Tuning AGENTS.md Stabilizes Long-Horizon Task Execution in Astra
items.body: Builders discuss stabilizing Astra by refining AGENTS.md conventions, preventing premature termination and erratic reasoning loops without requiring expensive multi-turn prompting.

items.title: @Liv_Boeree: Terence Tao Urges AI Deceleration: 'No Reason to Be This Fast'
items.body: Fields medalist Terence Tao calls for a deliberate slowdown in AI development pace, arguing that rapid, unconstrained deployment provides little tangible benefit compared to the mounting systemic coordination risks.

items.title: @bbcchinese: Trump Plans Unprecedented Airport Reception for Xi Jinping
items.body: Reports indicate US President Donald Trump will personally greet Chinese President Xi Jinping on the airport tarmac, marking the first such presidential airport reception for a visiting foreign head of state in over six decades.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Harry Kane Reflects on 45-Year Bayern Ballon d'Or Drought
items.body: Following Bayern Munich's dominant run, Harry Kane discusses Ballon d'Or prospects, acknowledging Bayern has not claimed the award since Karl-Heinz Rummenigge in 1981 while praising fellow contenders Michael Olise and Kylian Mbappé.

items.title: @Peregrino1708: The Brutal Economics and Pay Structure of Oktoberfest Servers
items.body: As Munich's Oktoberfest kicks off, an insider breakdown reveals servers front €1.5k–€3.5k in tokens/attire, purchase beer at wholesale to earn margins plus tips, and walk 50k steps carrying 10+ steins to make €5k–€12k over two weeks.

items.title: @mubeitech: Charlie Munger's Golden Rule on Elon Musk: Extreme Luck, Never Bet
items.body: A viral retrospective highlights Charlie Munger's assessment of Elon Musk—recognizing his repeated survival through extreme leverage and luck, while maintaining a strict policy to never invest with nor bet against him.

items.title: @emrenakyol: German EV Bureaucracy Fines Plugged-In Tesla in Charging Spot
items.body: A Tesla driver in Konstanz plugged into an active EV charging stall returns to find a municipal parking violation, discovering local regulations mandate a physical German EV badge regardless of the vehicle or charging cable.
